subject: ingles
statement:
Lee el texto original de práctica:
“Leo is a first-year student. He lives with his aunt and takes the bus to class. On weekdays he reviews his notes for twenty minutes after dinner. On Saturdays he meets a study group at the library. He wants to study engineering, but he has not chosen a university yet.”

Who does Leo live with?
explanation:
1. La evidencia pertinente es: “He lives with his aunt”.
2. El parentesco y la convivencia aparecen explícitamente.
3. La respuesta respaldada por el texto es: His aunt.

subject: ingles
statement:
Lee el texto original de práctica:
“For a classroom diary, Mara wrote: “I packed rice, beans and fruit for lunch. I brought water in a reusable bottle. My friend bought a sandwich. We ate after our morning classes.” The diary describes one school day; it does not give medical advice.”

What did Mara pack for lunch?
options: A sandwich bought by her friend.
explanation:
1. La evidencia pertinente es: “I packed rice, beans and fruit for lunch.”.
2. La lista pertenece al almuerzo de Mara, no al de su amiga.
3. La respuesta respaldada por el texto es: Rice, beans and fruit.
